decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered  therewith (950 PL-01 received 6 September 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, except where amended as detailed in condition 3 of this permission or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, the brickwork of the front wall hereby approved, with the exception of the piers, shall have a maximum height above ground level of 600mm.
Condition : 4 - The brickwork of the front wall hereby approved shall match the face brickwork of the front elevation of the house on the application site.
description: Erection of replacement front boundary wall and construction of hard standing on the forecourt.
